scripts.doctor: cd apps/app && APP_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=flagship pnpm dlx expo-doctor
scripts.deps:check: APP_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=flagship pnpm --dir apps/app exec expo install --check
scripts.dev: APP_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=flagship pnpm --dir apps/app exec expo start
scripts.export:web: APP_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=cotijuba-web pnpm --dir apps/app exec expo export -p web
scripts.export:web:serra: APP_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=serra-web pnpm --dir apps/app exec expo export -p web
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm i18n:check && pnpm brand-colors:check && pnpm test
